volatility.definition: vol20_t = sqrt(252) * sample_std(log(AdjClose_i / AdjClose_{i-1}), last 20 returns, ddof=1)

combinedBaseline.definition: baselineScore = z_mom - z_vol (z_mom and z_vol computed via training-window-only mean/std)
combinedBaseline.enhancedModel: y = alpha + beta * baselineScore + gamma * moduleSignalFeature

evaluationConstraints.commonSample: baseline and enhanced must be evaluated on exactly the same train rows and test rows

deltaR2.interpretation: > 0 = enhanced better than baseline, = 0 = no improvement, < 0 = enhanced worse

oosSignificanceTest.primaryTest: HAC-adjusted loss differential test AND moving-block bootstrap CI on d_t
oosSignificanceTest.primaryCondition: Mean OOS loss improvement > 0 AND bootstrap CI / HAC evidence supports improvement
